head: codex/5698-runtime-v3-redb-state
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][state] Unify durable kernel state on redb
body:
Closes #5698

Unifies Runtime v3 local adapter and governed-operation durable state on one redb-backed kernel store. The implementation replaces checkpoint.json/lifelog.jsonl persistence with `runtime-kernel.redb`, enforces an explicit absolute configured state root, fails closed when legacy flat persistence is present, preserves identity/integrity validation for restored checkpoint bytes, and retains the existing writer-lock and governed-operation behavior without fixture or receipt-only storage.

Validation passed through typed C-SDLC PVF: durable_state 4/4 including the concurrent sequence/head regression, assembly 9/9, governed_operations 28/28, strict all-target Clippy, and git diff hygiene.

Gemini 3.1 Pro performed the bounded exact-head review. Its initial concurrency finding was fixed by allocating redb sequence numbers in the same write transaction as row/head persistence; the remediation verification returned PASS / no findings.
